reason: I like the lab report and the QR code, but $25 for 30 days is about $0.83 a day, and I can get magnesium glycinate at the store or online for a lot less per day. I wait for a flash sale or coupon, and a launch price of $24.99 does not feel like a deal to me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule for less per day? And it is made in China, so I would want the lab report to really be there before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: A TikTok Shop flash sale or coupon that brings a box to about $15 to $17, or a clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats the multi-form blends.
